name: Bar dock
author: ozz1ee
description: One chevron in the corner of the bar that opens a square dock for the icons you keep off the bar. Drop an icon on the chevron to dock it, drag it out again to put it back.

barWidget.description: Keeps the bar icons you do not use behind one chevron, in a square dock you drag them in and out of

schema.label: Icon cell size
schema.description: Side of one cell in the dock grid, in pixels.

schema.label: Smallest square
schema.description: The dock is never smaller than this; a 3x3 grid of icons fits inside it.

schema.label: Largest side (px, 0 = screen)
schema.description: Optional cap on the drawer. 0 means no cap: the drawer grows with its icons until the screen stops it.

schema.label: Dock an icon dropped on the chevron
schema.description: Off means the chevron only opens the dock and icons are docked from the terminal.

schema.label: Dock drop margin (px)
schema.description: How far around the chevron a release still docks. The drawer itself only opens when the dragged icon is on the chevron, so this never disturbs reordering. 0 = the chevron's own slot only.

schema.label: Drop window (ms)
schema.description: How long after a drag last hovered the chevron a drop beside it still counts as docking.

schema.label: Smallest cell (px)
schema.description: How small the icons may be drawn when a lot of them have to fit the screen. The drawer stays square.

schema.label: Clear a dead drag after (ms)
schema.description: Last-resort guard: a drag that has not moved for this long is treated as lost. Lost drags are normally cleared immediately, as soon as no live pointer is behind them.
